comments.content: The fix changes "PRE_ARBITRATION" to match the enum variant name, but the original code had "PRE_ARBITRATION" (with an 'I') while the enum variant is PreArbitration. This looks correct now, but verify the Braintree webhook actually sends "PRE_ARBITRATION" (with 'I') and not "PRE_ARBITRATION" (with 'E').
Struct renamed from FiuuWebhookSignauture to FiuuWebhookSignature. Ensure all references to this struct across the codebase have been updated (grep for FiuuWebhookSignauture).
Field renamed from partiall_refund_payment to partially_refund_payment. Verify this matches the actual Worldpay API response field name and that all usages in the codebase are updated.
Parameter renamed from setup_futture_usage_intent to setup_future_usage_intent. Confirm all call sites of make_new_payment_attempt have been updated to use the new parameter name.

Macro parameter changed from tag_delimeter to tag_delimiter. This is a breaking change for any external crates using this macro. Since this is internal, verify all internal invocations (like in types.rs line 1362) have been updated.
